description: This file defines an abstract base class 'WorkItemBase' within the Orleans.Runtime.Scheduler namespace, representing a work item with properties and methods for execution, string formatting, and context information.

classes.name: WorkItemBase
classes.description: An abstract class representing a work item with properties for grain context and name, and methods for execution and string formatting.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the work item.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Overrides Object.ToString() to provide a string representation of the work item.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Attempts to format the work item into a provided span, returning success status and number of characters written.
